entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: An impish businessman and spy-network owner of Ravnica, a member of the Orzhov Syndicate and friend of Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild to which Pivlic belonged.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Pivlic does business.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A Wojek and good friend of Pivlic, whose spirit later resided in another body.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Orchestrator of the Decamillennial incident, defeated by Kos and Pivlic.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: A baroness whom Pivlic represented in Utvara.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: A figure whose plans to destroy Niv-Mizzet and seize control of the plane were overthrown.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A figure targeted by Zomaj Hauc's plans.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: A being who healed Pivlic with teardrops.

entities.name: Obez Murzeddi
entities.description: An Azorius lawmage in whose body Kos's spirit resided.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: A figure whose treachery Pivlic witnessed unravel.

entities.name: Utvara Reclamation Zone
entities.description: The zone where Pivlic ran a small inn.

entities.name: The Imp Wing Hotel and Bar
entities.description: A small inn owned by Pivlic.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: A Wojek whose salary Pivlic managed.

events.summary: Pivlic aided Agrus Kos during the Decamillennial incident orchestrated by Szadek.
events.quote: aided him during the Decamillennial incident orchestrated by Szadek

events.summary: Pivlic convinced Kos to relocate with him to the Utvara Reclamation Zone.
events.quote: Pivlic convinced Kos to relocate with him to the Utvara Reclamation Zone

events.summary: Pivlic aided Kos and Teysa Karlov in overthrowing Zomaj Hauc.
events.quote: Pivlic aided Kos and Teysa Karlov in overthrowing Zomaj Hauc

events.summary: Pivlic was established as Teysa Karlov's primary representative in Utvara.
events.quote: Pivlic was then officially established as the primary representative of Baroness Teysa Karlov in Utvara.

events.summary: Gravely wounded during the nephilim rampage, Pivlic was healed by Crixizix.
events.quote: miraculously healed by Crixizix with the help of teardrops

events.summary: Pivlic reunited with Kos, whose spirit was in Obez Murzeddi's body, and sabotaged the engine core of the Parhelion to defeat Szadek and Augustin.
events.quote: sabotaging the engine core of the Parhelion
